description: Conduct a comprehensive security audit of a web application codebase. Search for vulnerabilities across 5 categories: (1) Hardcoded credentials (API keys, secrets, passwords), (2) Weak cryptography (MD5, SHA1 for passwords), (3) SQL injection (string concatenation in queries), (4) XSS vulnerabilities (innerHTML, dangerouslySetInnerHTML), (5) Command injection (eval, exec). Create two files in the workspace root: (1) SECURITY_AUDIT.md - a structured report with findings organized by category (Hardcoded Credentials, Weak Cryptography, SQL Injection, XSS Vulnerabilities, Dangerous Functions), each finding must include file location, description, and severity level (Critical/High/Medium/Low), document at least 8 specific vulnerabilities total; (2) SECURITY_TODO.md - a prioritized remediation plan with severity classifications. Use VSCode search (Ctrl+Shift+F) with regex patterns to find vulnerabilities systematically.
